title: Known Agents Registry
description: Schema for known-agents.json — merged directory registry of known AI coding agents from skills-manager and vercel-labs/skills.

updated_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 (section 5.6) date-time timestamp when this registry was generated or updated.

total_agents.description: Total number of agent entries in the agents array.

agents.description: List of known AI coding agents.

key.description: Unique identifier key for the agent.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent.

detect_dirs.description: Paths (using ~ for home) checked to detect whether the agent is installed.

global_skills_dir.description: Primary global skills directory path, or null if none.

alt_global_skills_dirs.description: Optional alternative global skills directories when upstream sources differ.

project_skills_dir.description: Project-relative skills directory path, or null if not applicable.

additional_scan_dirs.description: Additional directories scanned for skill discovery.

sources.description: Source identifiers where this agent definition originated.
